name: Mei Chen
summary: Data analyst who builds Tableau dashboards and offered to help design charts for evaluation results.

notes.text: Mei Chen, data analyst at Bayline Terminals (container terminal at the port). Builds Tableau dashboards for vessel turnaround times. Met at a women in data event that my roommate took me to.
Mei sent me her dashboard style guide. She offered to help make our evaluation results look good - charts, dashboard layout. Strong in SQL too.
